messages:
Maria Gomez: Quick heads-up — we’re opening a 48-hour reviewer backfill window starting now for anyone overloaded (>6 reviews). If you can take 1–3 extra reviews this week, please sign up. We need backups for late-form submissions and LOA coverage.

Jack Patel: +1. Is there a short signup link/form?

Maria Gomez: Yup — form here: https://forms.redwood.com/reviewer-backfill (short fields: name, email, max extra reviews, timezone). Also dropping a tiny bulk CSV format if folks on your teams want to onboard multiple reviewers quickly:```csv
reviewer_email,max_extra_reviews,notes
jack.patel@redwood.ai,2,can do evenings
li.wei@redwood.ai,1,prefer frontend folks
```

Li Wei: I can take one extra reviewer for EE/infra. Can someone confirm how assignments get routed (auto vs manual)?

Maria Gomez: Thanks Li. Assignments will be semi-automatic: people-ops will seed the extra reviewer pool, then the assignment script will round-robin by team and expertise tags. If you want to opt-out of certain teams, add a note on the form.

Ashley Chen: What’s the SLA for reviews once you pick up an extra? We should be clear so reviewers know expectations.

Maria Gomez: Good call. SLA for backfill reviewers = 72 hours from assignment to submission. We’ll mark them as "backfill" in the reviewer dashboard so PMs know it’s temporary.

Jack Patel: Will People Ops reassign if someone misses the 72h SLA?

People Ops Bot: automated-reminder: Sending reminder emails to backfill reviewers 24h before SLA expiry and at SLA expiry. Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/backfill-sla

Maria Gomez: If a reviewer misses SLA, People Ops will reassign to next available backfill reviewer and flag manager. We’ll keep the script logs public in #eng-oncall for transparency.

Li Wei: One more ask — can we get an export of which review forms are flagged 'high-effort' so volunteers can pick? Saves time.

Maria Gomez: Yes — adding a filter to the signup form ("prefer high-effort forms") and we’ll include a short list in the signup confirmation email.

Ashley Chen: Thanks — I’ll circulate this to my team. Anyone who wants bulk onboarding, DM me and I’ll help upload the CSV.

Maria Gomez: Awesome — thanks all. If you signed up, expect assignment notifications from People Ops in the next 6–24h. Please ping me here for any exceptions. :thumbsup:
